facts.fact: The Assembly's Rights and Freedoms Committee held a hearing on organic-law proposal 095/2025 on personal data protection, which is before parliament, per webdo relaying TAP.
facts.system: Organic-law proposal 095/2025 on personal data protection

facts.fact: A Ministry of Health representative told the committee that the Instance de protection des donnees personnelles has ceased its activities since 2024.
facts.system: Instance de protection des donnees personnelles (INPDP)

facts.fact: The Health Ministry's representative said its Centre national de l'informatique, set up by legislation, manages and develops the ministry's digital health systems and oversees data processing, transfer and infrastructure security.
